claimed_coverage: Tests that the cancerit-allelecount recipe fix is correctly applied by verifying meta.yaml has linux-aarch64 in additional-platforms, build number 7, run_exports, GPL-3.0-only license fields, and build.sh uses set -xeu and parallel make with -j ${CPU_COUNT}.
fix_patch_grounding: The tests verify the concrete changes from fix.patch: build.sh changes set -eu to set -xeu and adds -j ${CPU_COUNT} to make; meta.yaml adds linux-aarch64 to additional-platforms, updates build number to 7, adds run_exports with pin_subpackage, and updates license fields to GPL-3.0-only with license_file and license_family.
issue_context_used: The issue describes making the recipe work on linux-aarch64 platform, which requires updating additional-platforms metadata, adding parallel make for efficient ARM builds, and proper license/run_exports metadata for conda packaging standards.
notes: Hidden tests created under /artifacts/evaluation/tests/ since test.patch was not present. Tests use text-based verification to handle Jinja2 templating in conda recipes. All 8 tests fail on buggy workspace and pass on fixed workspace.
